chunks.title: About Algovia AI
chunks.content:
Algovia AI is a leading AI Transformation and Execution firm that helps organizations move from strategy to execution, adoption, and measurable value. It combines senior business transformation expertise with AI build capability to deliver solutions embedded into operating models, workflows, governance, and performance management.

Algovia is not a traditional consultancy and not a software vendor — it is the partner that connects both, and stays accountable until AI becomes business as usual.

Algovia AI works primarily with Boards and Executive teams across governments and enterprises in the UAE, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Europe, and Australia, backed by an international network of AI and industry experts, and delivered through an advisory, implementation, and value-realization engagement model.

Vision: To lead globally in intelligent AI execution, enabling people and industries to operate with greater impact, agility, and autonomy.

Mission: Algovia creates competitive advantage through AI-driven execution that combines deep research, industry expertise, and the activation of organizational knowledge to deliver innovation, agility, and measurable impact at scale.

Founded by business transformation executives and AI builders — the four co-founders are:
- Houssam Abiad, Board Director & Co-Founder — former Deputy Lord Mayor, 20+ years across public, private, and startup sectors, urban and infrastructure transformation.
- Mohamad Kinawi, Board Director & Co-Founder — electronic engineer, AI strategist, and investment banker with global experience in London, Frankfurt, and Shanghai.
- Lara El Khayat, Chief Executive Officer & Co-Founder — 24 years of advisory experience across GRC and Business Transformation, former Partner at global consulting firms, worked with ADNOC, Mubadala, Majid Al Futtaim, TAQA, Saudia.
- Carmen Hamze, Business Partner & Co-Founder — 14+ years advising public-sector and energy organizations across the GCC, former Partner at Roland Berger and Monitor Deloitte.

Extended leadership includes Marek Tatara, PhD (Chief Scientific Officer / Head of AI) and Łukasz Fedorowicz (Head of AI Design), plus a Chief Technology Officer.

Algovia works with a network of 700+ cross-disciplinary professionals across Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, and Digital and Business Transformation, spanning 9 industry sectors: Government & Public Sector, Financial Services, Energy, Technology/Media/Telecommunications, Real Estate, Healthcare, Education, Transport & Aviation, and Retail & Manufacturing.

Offices: Dubai, UAE and Jeddah, KSA. General contact: connect@algovia.ai.

chunks.title: Let's Engage — the seven engagement models
chunks.content:
Algovia has seven signature engagement models, each scoped around a business outcome:

01. AI Value Discovery Sprint — Sprint (2–3 Weeks). AI workshop including an executive diagnostic & 2–3 prioritized use cases. Outcome: a business case leadership can act on, not just an informative slide deck.

02. AI Training Sprint — Sprint (1–2 Weeks). Role-based AI training tailored to your sector and teams. Outcome: teams that can use AI, not just talk about it.

03. AI Transformation Roadmap — Strategic Engagement. Maturity diagnostic resulting in use-case prioritization, AI roadmap & change plan. Outcome: an AI roadmap tied to budget, timeline, and named owners.

04. AI Proof of Value & Solution Build — Build Engagement. AI solution design, agile build & testing, and business integration. Outcome: an AI solution live in your operating environment that scales with your business.

05. Business Transformation & Change Management — Advisory Engagement. Operating model and business process diagnostic and transformation to enable effective change management and target realization. Outcome: enhanced operating model and lean business processes that deliver tangible business value.

06. AI Governance, Risk and Compliance Management — Advisory Engagement. AI risk, governance and compliance framework and controls mapping to maintain accountability and ethical standards. Outcome: governance that regulators and boards can rely on.

07. AI Adoption & Value Realization Office — Managed Service. AI adoption monitoring, KPI dashboards, and continuous optimization. Outcome: value that is measured, sustained, and scaled long after AI solution go-live.

Every engagement starts with a conversation about the outcome the client is aiming to achieve — not a generic sales call. Visitors can schedule a meeting directly through the "Schedule a Meeting" form on the Service Offerings page, which asks for name, work email, company, job title, country/market, area of interest (the engagement model), preferred meeting format, and an optional message.

chunks.title: How to get started with Algovia
chunks.content:

- Network — senior practitioners, former operators, and industry specialists can apply to Algovia's expert network (an affiliate/associate pool, distinct from full-time hiring) via the Network form on the Company page.

Algovia does not do generic sales calls — every conversation starts with the outcome the visitor is trying to achieve.

chunks.title: Research & Learn — Thought Leadership and Algovia Academy
chunks.content:
Research & Learn has two parts:

Thought Leadership — a content hub for articles, points of view, and short-form insights, supported by a steady cadence of shorter pieces and LinkedIn-native posts. Content is in development; do not invent article titles or authors.

Algovia Academy — Algovia's public-facing brand for its training capability, directly extending the AI Training engagement model (see engagements) into a standing, ongoing program. Algovia Academy builds AI literacy across an entire organization — from sales and operations to support functions — moving from foundational AI literacy through hands-on practitioner skills to deeper technical tracks for teams building alongside Algovia, all grounded in real use cases. It meets board-level literacy needs, role-based team training, and technical upskilling for build engagements alike. Visitors interested in a training program can schedule a meeting via the Schedule a Meeting flow.

chunks.title: Service Portfolio — AI & Digital Solutions and Intelligent Business Solutions
chunks.content:
Algovia's Service Portfolio has two categories, twelve capabilities total.

AI & Digital Solutions — the build capabilities behind Algovia's execution:
- AI Strategy — AI strategic initiatives & roadmap, AI solution scoping. Concentrates investment on use cases that move the P&L.
- Artificial Intelligence — Agentic AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, AI Consulting, Agentic AI Security & Governance. Faster decisions and business automation, governed the way boards expect.
- Computer Vision — Object detection, image & video analysis, quality inspection, industrial automation. Fewer defects, less downtime, cost optimization.
- Software Development — Enterprise platforms, cloud-native applications, back & front-end development, mobile applications. Modern platforms that operate faster and cost less to run.
- Data Engineering & Analytics — Data platforms, business intelligence, predictive analytics, data science, automated doc & CAD analysis. One source of truth for quick, effective decisions.
- IoT & Embedded Systems — Custom hardware & firmware, Internet of Things, on-board/edge processing, connectivity & sensors. Infrastructure that scales with the business.

Intelligent Business Solutions — the governance and transformation capabilities Algovia embeds alongside every AI build:
- Strategy & Operating Model — Business & digital strategy, SMO & PMO, operating model development & transformation. Built to compete in a disrupted market.
- Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) — Corporate governance, risk management, compliance management, policies & procedures. A competitive advantage, not a compliance checkbox.
- Cost Optimization — AI-enabled cost optimization assessment & solutions. Savings delivered without cutting into what clients experience.
- Business Transformation — Business process transformation, customer experience transformation. Leaner processes and better customer experience.
- Capital Markets Solutions — IPO readiness assessment, IPO GRC framework implementation. Quick alignment to listing requirements under tight deadlines.
- Internal Audit & ICFR — AI-enabled internal audit services, digitized ICFR services. Financial and process control gaps identified and mitigated in real time.

chunks.title: Success Stories — Financial Services
chunks.content:
Financial Services success story:

Kinage: AI Personal-Finance MVP — Bills, subscriptions, scam messages, and other financial events arrived in inconsistent formats that were hard to track. Algovia built a secure inbox connector and parsing pipeline that extracts merchants, amounts, and due dates, then classifies bills, subscriptions, scams, and anomalies into clear alerts inside a full-stack application. Results: accelerated market launch with a functional MVP, reduced future rework through a modular foundation, improved visibility and control over financial risk, and tangible evidence to support fundraising. Technology: Python, NLP, Classification Models, AWS.

chunks.title: Success Stories — Healthcare
chunks.content:
Healthcare success stories:

Everon: Remote Patient-Care Device Re-Architecture — Redesigned nursing-device firmware around BLE, Bluetooth Classic, and GSM/MBIM links with DSP for noise/echo cancellation, extending battery life to about two days and adding multi-patient monitoring.

DiaperID: Parent-Facing App Screening for Liver-Disease Indicators — A React Native app guides parents through image capture; a Python computer-vision model trained on clinically annotated images screens for biliary atresia indicators under an MDR-aware validation workflow.

motus med: Accelerating Infant Seizure Diagnosis with Computer Vision — An AI-driven tool uses smartphone videos taken by parents to enable rapid, accurate detection of infantile spasms, accelerating diagnosis and treatment (MDR Class IIb certification support).

METIS: Point-of-Care Antibiotic Decision Support — Combines clinical recommendation logic with computer-vision analysis of diagnostic inputs in a mobile-compatible, clinician-facing interface for same-visit prescribing guidance.

CaReHigh: Mobile Patient Platform and Registry for FH Care & Research — A React Native app and Python backend support onboarding, adherence tracking, and research participation for familial hypercholesterolemia patients.

Mayo Clinic: Benchmarked Medical-Imaging Pipeline for Stroke Etiology Classification — An end-to-end AI system combining curated image repositories, HistomicsTK preprocessing, and a specialized deep-learning model (PyTorch, MONAI) achieved a Silver Medal benchmark: 46th of 896 teams on Kaggle.

If asked about these sectors, say honestly that dedicated case studies are still in development — do not invent client names, metrics, or outcomes for them.

chunks.title: Success Stories — Real Estate
chunks.content:
Real Estate success stories:

Eazli: Scalable Multi-Agent Marketplace for KSA Property, Lifestyle & Services — Eazli's early prototype could only handle simple, single-service requests, with no way to break complex needs into tasks, activate the right specialists, or give management visibility into service quality and AI costs. Algovia designed a central AI concierge that interprets each customer's needs, plans and delegates tasks to specialist agents through standardized interfaces, and shares context through RAG, with built-in monitoring of performance, quality, and per-query cost. Results: enabled new services to launch without rebuilding the core platform, cut the time and cost of integrating new specialist capabilities, opened cross-selling opportunities, and gave management real-time control over quality and AI spend. Technology: Python, LLM Orchestration, RAG, AWS.

Oculo: Turning On-Site Data into Actionable Construction Insights — Construction teams needed a single, reliable source of truth for on-site progress. Algovia's deep-tech team co-developed computer vision algorithms using 360° cameras to create an up-to-date "street view" of a construction project, delivering full-stack computer vision, frontend, backend, and mobile. Technology: OpenCV, Python, AWS, React, Kotlin, Swift.

chunks.title: Success Stories — Retail & Manufacturing
chunks.content:
Retail & Manufacturing success stories (Algovia's largest sector by case-study count):

STIHL: Enterprise-Wide Agentic AI Governance Strategy — Consolidated dozens of fragmented AI initiatives into a centralized adoption plan across SAP, Databricks, and Microsoft Azure environments, with education, use-case prioritization, and a data governance strategy.

AIMS5.0 (EU Horizon programme): Edge AI and OT/IT Architecture for Real-Time Manufacturing — Placed inference close to machines for air-gapped, security-sensitive production lines, defining OT/IT bridge and sensor-fusion patterns.

Prohan: Computer Vision Defect Detection in Wood Furniture Manufacturing — Detected cracks and gaps tenths of a millimetre wide immediately after gluing, 24/7 in low light and dust. Results: 90% defect detection during production, 0% defects in final products, 0% returns from undetected flaws.

Gold Guard: Handheld Edge-AI Jewellery Authentication — Combined macro imaging, cross-polarized/coaxial lighting, IMU-gated capture, and a quantized edge-AI verification model; returns a result in under five seconds.

PNK Group: AI-Powered Defect Detection for Precast Concrete — Handheld 3D scanners and a mobile multi-camera rig detect geometric deviations and surface flaws with real-time alerts; modular system expected to cut future adaptation costs 20–30%.

ALTANA: Advanced Quality Inspection for Paint Monitoring — Colorimetric-camera computer vision for automated, real-time color-consistency checks and predictive defect flagging.

Edible Oil Producer: Automated Defective Cap Detection for High-Speed Bottling — Real-time vision system identifies cracked, loose, or missing caps on a 270-bottle-per-minute line, integrated with the existing rejection system.

10Beauty: Autonomous Manicure Innovation with Precise Computer Vision — 3D hand-positioning and nail-segmentation pipeline (accuracy greater than 0.25mm) improved efficiency by over 10x for automated manicure application.

H2TRAIN: Wearable Edge-to-Cloud Industrial Safety Platform — Integrated ECG, respiration, temperature, and movement sensors with on-device sensor fusion (TensorFlow Lite) and digital-twin cloud models for earlier warning of unsafe conditions.

Komatsu: Forest Mapping with Autonomous, Computer-Vision-Extended Drones — Drone-based 3D surface reconstruction and tree characterization (diameter, species, bend) fusing RGB camera and LiDAR data ahead of harvesting.

SatVitAi (EU Horizon Europe AGRARIAN programme, Open Call winner): Satellite Edge AI for Precision Viticulture — On-device inference pipeline for near-real-time vine maturity, disease, and yield-anomaly detection on satellite-grade edge hardware without continuous cloud connectivity.

Furniture Manufacturer: Multimodal Engineering Copilot for Drawings, Product Matching & BOMs (illustrative example, not a named client) — A copilot extracting dimensions from CAD drawings, matching them to a product library, and generating BOMs and proposal content to accelerate quotation turnaround.

chunks.title: Success Stories — Technology, Media & Telecommunications
chunks.content:
Technology, Media & Telecommunications success stories:

TalkTwelve: Production Legal AI Platform — An employment-law service received open-ended client enquiries lacking key facts; solicitors spent over 60 minutes per case before a consultation could begin. Algovia built a conversational AI agent that asks targeted follow-up questions, retrieves approved legal content through RAG, and converts each enquiry into a structured, solicitor-ready brief, deployed securely on AWS. Result: cut intake time from over 60 minutes to about 12 minutes. Technology: Python, React, Qdrant, Keycloak, AWS.

Invisible Technologies: Data Platform Rebuilt for Reliability & Cost Control — A Databricks medallion architecture scaled without operational control: pipeline failures went undetected and cloud costs accumulated without attribution. Algovia built data-quality monitoring across all three medallion layers, local testing before production, hash-based deduplication, and granular cost dashboards. Technology: Python, PySpark, Databricks, Temporal, Delta Lake.

Major European Telecom Operator: Automated Fibre Optic Installation Validation — Manual inspection of fibre installations was slow and inconsistent. Algovia developed a real-time computer vision and machine learning inspection system. Technology: Python, PyTorch, OpenCV, FastAPI.

Intel Poland / Revoize: Revolutionizing In-Car Speech Enhancement — Algovia's GenAI Audio R&D initiative set new real-time audio processing standards through microphone-array geometry design and iterative DSP algorithm development, exceeding market incumbents including flagship Adobe products.

chunks.title: Success Stories — Transport & Aviation
chunks.content:
Transport & Aviation success story:

MuuMap (D-Box): Digitizing Milk Collection Logistics Across Europe — The dairy industry relied on manual route planning and limited real-time monitoring, with poor communication between plants, farmers, and drivers. Algovia developed MuuMap, a digital system streamlining milk collection logistics through real-time tracking, optimized route planning, and seamless dispatcher-driver communication, reducing collection times and fleet requirements. Technology: Java + Spring, Kotlin, React, OpenStreetMap, Python.

Note: this is a fleet-logistics and supply-chain case study — Algovia's public-sector and enterprise engagements also extend into aviation-adjacent operational contexts as they arise, and this sector's client roster continues to grow.

chunks.title: Value Proposition & the AI Value Gap
chunks.content:
Most firms stop at strategy or software. Algovia combines business transformation expertise, deep operational understanding, and proven AI execution to embed intelligent AI into the decisions, workflows, and operating models that drive real performance.

Four pillars:
1. Senior Business Transformation Expertise — Algovia's team has led enterprise-scale transformation programs across governments and large corporations as accountable execution owners, not just advisers.
2. Deep Cross-Sector Operational Understanding — having operated inside the functions and industry sectors it transforms, Algovia designs solutions tailored to how the business actually works, not generic frameworks.
3. Proven AI Design & Execution Capability — 700+ cross-disciplinary AI professionals bring technical expertise rarely available in a single partner.
4. Digital Transformation & Change Management — Algovia embeds governance, business ownership, and process redesign into every engagement so solutions are embraced and sustained.

The AI Value Gap — the problem Algovia solves — has five recurring failure modes:

01. Ambition without Prioritization — organizations know AI matters but struggle to identify use cases that are material, feasible, and worth scaling. Algovia structures and prioritizes use cases, tying them to business targets.

02. Technology without Foundations — tools are deployed into environments not ready to support them, with fragmented data and systems in silos. Algovia diagnoses data and infrastructure readiness before any AI build begins.

03. Pilots without Adoption — AI initiatives stop at proof of concept because they aren't embedded into workflows, roles, or governance. Algovia embeds change management, business ownership, and process redesign to enable adoption.

04. Advice without Accountability — advisory consulting stops at recommendations; technology vendors stop at deployment; no one is accountable for outcomes. Algovia bridges the gap, embedding governance, risk, and controls from day one, remaining accountable for delivery, adoption, and measurable outcomes.

05. Impact without Measurement — benefits are promised but rarely tracked through clear KPIs, baselines, and value realization routines. Algovia anchors engagements in client targets and KPIs to ensure impact is realized and sustained.
